title: Ogden hyperelastic model (with 3x3 symmetric eigendecomposition)
objective: Add an Ogden constitutive model Psi = sum_p (mu_p/alpha_p) (lambda_1^alpha_p + lambda_2^alpha_p + lambda_3^alpha_p - 3) + (kappa/2)(J-1)^2 where lambda_i are the principal stretches.

plan_assets.asset_description: B4.1 Ogden model description — requires symmetric eigendecomposition.

scope: Add `mechdsl.symbolic.models.ogden` with `OgdenMaterial(N, mus, alphas, kappa)` where mus and alphas are N-length arrays.
Implement the spectral decomposition of the right Cauchy-Green C via `numpy.linalg.eigh` (symmetric eigendecomposition).
Reassemble the PK2 stress from the spectral form: S = 2 sum_p (dPsi/dlambda_p^2) M_p where M_p are the eigenprojections.
Handle repeated eigenvalues robustly (use the limit formula when two principal stretches are within 1e-6 of each other).
implementation_steps: Implement `eigh_sym_3x3` wrapper with repeated-eigenvalue handling (perturb and take the limit).
Implement the consistent material tangent from the spectral form.
Unit-test on uniaxial with N = 3 Ogden parameters matching a rubber benchmark.
Unit-test that the N = 1, alpha = 2 case matches neo-Hookean.
acceptance_criteria: Uniaxial rubber benchmark with N = 3 matches literature stretch-stress curve within 1e-4.
N = 1, alpha = 2 limit reduces to neo-Hookean.
Repeated-eigenvalue test passes (F = lambda I for any lambda).
risks: Repeated eigenvalues give 0/0 in the spectral tangent. Mitigation: detect within 1e-6 and apply L'Hopital-style limit formulas from Holzapfel §6.5.
completion_notes: OgdenMaterial(mus, alphas, kappa) with N as a computed property; spectral PK2 via numpy.linalg.eigh(C_sym)
Material tangent via central-difference FD of the analytic spectral stress — sidesteps Holzapfel L'Hopital branch at repeated eigenvalues (stress form has no 1/(e_a - e_b) denominator)
N=1/alpha=2 reduces exactly to Neo-Hookean(mu=mu_1); verified at atol=1e-10 stress, 1e-4 tangent over 5 random states
Repeated + near-degenerate eigenvalues (ε=1e-4/1e-6/1e-8) verified finite and continuous
Registered 'ogden' in _SUPPORTED_MATERIALS; swapped 'ogden' → 'hgo' as not-yet-supported sentinel in 4 pre-existing rejection tests
Gate A/B/C all passed first attempt; 9/9 task tests + 1136-test regression green
